curated_restore.name: Burger
curated_restore.why: Bun is defining; corpus had 32% (below 40% threshold). A burger without a bun is just a patty.

curated_restore.name: Pesto pasta
curated_restore.why: Pine nuts are defining in pesto; corpus underweights them when recipes use jarred pesto (just 'pesto' as one NER token).

curated_restore.name: Wonton soup
curated_restore.why: It is literally a soup. Corpus tags water+bouillon, not 'broth' subcategory, so this fell below threshold.

curated_restore.name: Caramel popcorn
curated_restore.why: Popcorn IS the substrate; corpus had 38% (below 40%). Caramel popcorn without popcorn is just caramel.

curated_restore.name: Biscuits and gravy
curated_restore.why: Sausage gravy is defining; corpus had 38% Processed meat + 38% Red meat (both below 40%, but combined evidence is clear).

curated_restore.name: Pierogi (potato-cheese)
curated_restore.why: The name explicitly states the filling (potato-cheese). Removing these contradicts the dish identity.

curated_restore.name: Swedish meatballs
curated_restore.why: Served in cream gravy; corpus had 35% (below 40%). Jams & preserves (lingonberry) was below 10%, not restored.

curated_add.name: Pancakes & syrup

curated_add.name: Peanut butter sandwich
curated_add.why: PB&J — Temperate fruits was a proxy for jelly/jam; replace with the correct Jams & preserves category.

curated_add.name: Hummus plate
curated_add.why: Tahini (nut butter) and lemon juice are defining hummus ingredients.

curated_add.name: Cheeseburger
curated_add.why: Ketchup/mustard (Sauces) and pickles (Pickled vegetables) are core to a cheeseburger.

curated_add.name: Yogurt parfait
curated_add.why: Granola is the carb component; without it, this is just yogurt + berries.

curated_add.name: Cereal bowl
curated_add.why: Most breakfast cereals carry added sugar.

curated_add.name: Sashimi platter
curated_add.why: Soy sauce + wasabi are the defining condiments.

curated_add.name: Egg fried rice
curated_add.why: Soy sauce is essential. Untouched in Pass 1 (n=19, just below 20). Corpus has Sauces at 58%.

curated_add.name: Larb
curated_add.why: Fish sauce is the defining ingredient of larb.

curated_add.name: Tom yum goong
curated_add.why: Fish sauce and lemongrass/lime leaves are core. Pass 1 left this untouched (low corpus support).

curated_add.name: Mole poblano with chicken
curated_add.why: Chocolate is the defining ingredient that distinguishes mole poblano.

compositional.name: Mulled apple wine
compositional.why: Defining mulled-wine ingredients (cinnamon stick, cloves, sugar, orange). Pass 1's strip left it as just wine + fruit.

compositional.name: Béchamel base
compositional.why: Béchamel = roux (butter + flour) + milk + salt. Pass 1 stripped sugar correctly but left it missing flour.

compositional.name: Compound butter
compositional.why: Compound butter is butter blended with herbs/garlic/aromatics; the strip left it identical to plain butter.

compositional.name: Apple milkshake
compositional.why: A milkshake requires ice cream; the strip left it as just milk + apple.

compositional.name: Bread pudding base
compositional.why: Bread pudding custard is bread + milk + eggs + sugar. Pass 1 had bread + milk + sugar; missing eggs.
